disclaimer: Recommendations generated by AI Fit Teams from one assessment. Nothing here is an enforced control, a compliance attestation, or a measurement. Each item needs a human decision before it is adopted.

workload.name: Support ticket triage and refund handling

governanceRequirements.requirement: Redact or tokenise sensitive fields before the prompt is constructed.
governanceRequirements.rationale: Once data is in a provider request it is out of your control boundary, regardless of the retention promise in the contract.

verification.method: Control scans outbound prompt payloads for configured sensitive patterns and alerts on matches.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Pin an allow-list of approved providers, models and regions; deny everything else at the gateway.
governanceRequirements.rationale: Shadow AI is the common path by which regulated data reaches an unreviewed endpoint.

verification.method: Control flags any model ID or destination not on the allow-list.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Scope every tool credential to the narrowest permission that works. One service account per tool, not one per agent.
governanceRequirements.rationale: Excessive agent privilege is the most consistently reported blocker to production agent deployment.

verification.method: Control records which credential performed each action and flags use outside declared scope.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Human approval gate on: Issue refund (above the stated value ceilings).
governanceRequirements.rationale: The cost of a wrong autonomous action here exceeds the labour saved by removing the approval step.

verification.method: Control asserts an approval record exists for every gated action and alerts on any that executed without one.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Treat all retrieved and user-supplied content as untrusted data, never as instructions. Test with an adversarial injection suite in CI.
governanceRequirements.rationale: Prompt injection is not a prompt-engineering problem; it is an architecture problem solved by privilege separation.

verification.method: Control correlates injection-signature detections with subsequent tool calls.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Log every model call with workload, user, model, tokens, cost, latency, outcome and any action taken.
governanceRequirements.rationale: Without attribution you cannot answer "who spent this, on what, and what did it do" — the question that arrives first in any incident or audit.

verification.method: This is the ARK Control ingest contract; coverage is measurable as a percentage of known traffic.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Per-workload spend ceiling with an automatic circuit breaker.
governanceRequirements.rationale: An agent loop failure is a financial incident that runs at machine speed. Rate limits are a security control, not a billing preference.

verification.method: Control enforces the budget and records every trip of the breaker.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Confirm in writing that your vendor agreement covers this data class, on the plan you use.
governanceRequirements.rationale: Required by the deterministic decision rules for this workload.

verification.method: Confirm in the launch review that this is in place.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Keep a person reviewing outputs until you have measured the error rate on real examples.
governanceRequirements.rationale: Required by the deterministic decision rules for this workload.

verification.method: Confirm in the launch review that this is in place.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Do not paste data into a tool whose data-retention terms you have not read.
governanceRequirements.rationale: Required by the deterministic decision rules for this workload.

verification.method: Confirm in the launch review that this is in place.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Meet "Task accuracy on the golden set" at >= 97% before launch.
governanceRequirements.rationale: A launch-blocking acceptance criterion from the evaluation plan.

verification.method: Human-labelled holdout of 240 real examples, sampled across the full input distribution — not the easy ones.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Meet "Accuracy vs. the human baseline" at Error rate <= 4.0% (today's human rate) before launch.
governanceRequirements.rationale: A launch-blocking acceptance criterion from the evaluation plan.

verification.method: Same golden set, scored against how the current process actually performs.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Meet "Schema validity" at >= 99.5% first-pass before launch.
governanceRequirements.rationale: A launch-blocking acceptance criterion from the evaluation plan.

verification.method: Validator rejection rate at the gateway.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Meet "Unauthorised action rate" at 0 — any occurrence is a launch blocker before launch.
governanceRequirements.rationale: A launch-blocking acceptance criterion from the evaluation plan.

verification.method: Control compares every executed action against the declared tool allow-list and approval records.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Meet "Loop containment" at p99 turns per outcome within the configured cap before launch.
governanceRequirements.rationale: A launch-blocking acceptance criterion from the evaluation plan.

verification.method: Control turn distribution per trace. A long tail here is a cost incident forming.

governanceRequirements.requirement: Meet "Adversarial injection resistance" at 0 successful tool invocations from injected instructions before launch.
governanceRequirements.rationale: A launch-blocking acceptance criterion from the evaluation plan.

verification.method: Red-team suite run in CI on every prompt or tool change.

policySuggestions.title: Human approval for consequential actions
policySuggestions.rationale: These actions are costly or irreversible. A person approves each call before it runs.

policySuggestions.title: Redact sensitive data before prompts are built
policySuggestions.rationale: Sensitive data classes are in scope; tokenise or redact them before any model sees them.

policySuggestions.title: Monthly model spend cap
policySuggestions.rationale: 1.5× the upper estimate of monthly run cost (heuristic). Revisit once real spend is measured.

policySuggestions.title: Cap model turns per outcome
policySuggestions.rationale: Twice the assumed turns per outcome for this pattern; stops runaway loops.

policySuggestions.title: Keep processing in the required region
policySuggestions.rationale: The intake states a data residency constraint.

policySuggestions.title: Restrict the agent to these tools
policySuggestions.rationale: Only the actions named in the assessment; anything else is denied.

agentInventory.reason: The recommended pattern takes actions or chains model calls, so it should be registered and owned as an agent.
